{"metadata":{"description":"An in-app browser pane for DeepSeek Harness — real Chrome over CDP, plus rendered previews of local files, markdown and PDFs.","id":"gh:1341381943","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"DeepSeek-Harness-Browser","slug":"tonyd2wild/DeepSeek-Harness-Browser","topics":["browser","cdp","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","preview"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"An in-app browser pane for DeepSeek Harness — real Chrome over CDP, plus rendered previews of local "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"files, markdown and PDFs."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness Browser"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> ### ⚠️ Unofficial community project
>
> **Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by DeepS"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"eek AI.** This is a
> third-party plugin for their open-source harness. For the official project see"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"
> deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.
> Please do not report issues with this repo to DeepSeek."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A browser pane inside the harness, beside the chat.** A real Chrome the human
can watch and type i"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"nto, plus rendered previews of local files — and three tools
that let the model drive it and read wh"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ed previews of local files — and three tools
that let the model drive it and read what is on screen."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The pane is a **real layout column**: the conversation gives up space rather than
being covered. Mea"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"sured 907px → 447px when it opens, and back on close."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Requires dsh 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer.** Web UI (profile `web`) and DeepSeek's
> desktop app (profile"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" `desktop`): both supported. In the desktop app the pane
> leases a real `<webview>` through the app"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"'s own browser bridge, so every site
> loads (no framing limits). Verified on 0.2.0-rc.1: CNN opened"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" by the agent,
> page text back to `read_preview` in about 1.5 s. (The desktop app has no public
> d"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ownload yet; it is built from DeepSeek's source.)
>
> **Using dsh 0.1.x?** Use the `dsh-0.1` tag
> o"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" it is built from DeepSeek's source.)
>
> **Using dsh 0.1.x?** Use the `dsh-0.1` tag
> of this repo."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Where this fits in dsh 0.2"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"dsh 0.2 ships browsing of its own. Pick what you actually need:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| you want | use |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| **A browser for yourself** in the desktop app | DeepSeek's built-in **sidebar browser** (`ui-sideb"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ar-browser`): a full `<webview>` with native history in the desktop app. In the web UI it is off by "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"default and falls back to an iframe, with the framing limits described below. |
| **To read a local "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"document** yourself | the built-in **document preview** sidebar (`ui-sidebar-documentpreview`): Mark"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"down, code, HTML, PDF, images, Office files. |
| **The agent to open a page and read what is on scre"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"en** | **this repo**: `open_preview` / `read_preview` / `close_preview`. The built-in sidebars regis"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ter no model tools; they are for you, not the agent. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Web pages open in a real Chrome**, driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol
with its own persisten"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"t profile. You can log in. You can type. Sites that refuse
to be framed work, because nothing is bei"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" You can log in. You can type. Sites that refuse
to be framed work, because nothing is being framed."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Local files are rendered**, not linked:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| kind | shown as |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `.md` | formatted document — headings, tables, code, task lists, quotes |
| `.html` | the real pag"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e, with its relative images and styles resolving |
| images | framed on the app background |
| **PDF"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"** | **page images**, rendered server-side — no browser PDF viewer needed |
| code / text / config |"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" syntax-framed with language and line count |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Clicking a link or a file path in the chat** opens it in the pane."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Saving a file to your own machine.** A **↓** button appears in the toolbar
whenever the pane is sh"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"owing a file. It serves the real bytes with
`Content-Disposition: attachment` rather than the render"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ed page you are looking
at. This matters most when the harness is on **another machine** — the file
"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"lives over there, and until now the pane only ever showed you a picture of it."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The button is deliberately absent for web pages: "download" is not a meaningful
action on a live pag"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"e, and a button that does nothing is worse than no button."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Why a real browser, and not an iframe"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"This is the central design decision, and it was reached by measurement rather
than preference. An if"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"rame cannot do this job, for three independent reasons:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. **Sites refuse to be framed.** `x.com` sends `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`
plus a CSP `frame-ance"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"stors 'self'`; `reddit.com` sends `SAMEORIGIN`. The
browser obeys, and the pane renders blank.
2. **"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"Cookies default to `SameSite=Lax`**, which the browser withholds inside a
cross-site iframe. Even a "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"framable site renders **signed out**, with a valid
session sitting right there unused.
3. A server-s"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ide proxy fetches anonymously, so it cannot hold a session at all."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Only (3) is fixable in userland, and fixing it would not have helped."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"So `cdpbrowser.js` launches Chrome with a dedicated profile, attaches to a page
target over one WebS"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ocket, and the pane mirrors it while forwarding clicks,
scroll and keystrokes back as CDP input even"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ts. No dependency is needed — CDP is
JSON over a socket, and Node has `fetch` and `WebSocket` built "},{"id":"p23s4","text":" No dependency is needed — CDP is
JSON over a socket, and Node has `fetch` and `WebSocket` built in."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**On cookies and safety.** A real browser is *safer* than the proxy it replaced,
not riskier: cookie"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s stay in Chrome's own encrypted store with per-origin
isolation and SameSite enforced by the browse"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"r. Nothing is copied into a jar of
this project's invention. The profile is **dedicated**, so the us"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"er's daily
browser is untouched (Chrome cannot open one profile twice) and a login here
persists."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- `dsh` **0.2.0-rc.1+**. npm's `latest` tag still points at 0.1.x at the time of
writing, so install"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" the 0.2 line explicitly: `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@next`
- **Node** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (needs "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"global `fetch` and `WebSocket`)
- **Chrome or Edge** — for the live browser
- **pnpm** — `dsh plugin"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"` shells out to it
- *Optional:* **Python + PyMuPDF** (`pip install pymupdf`) for PDF rendering.
Wit"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"hout it, PDFs fall back to the browser's own viewer."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"**The pane can hold real logged-in sessions.** It is driven by an agent. If that
agent runs without "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"approval prompts, it can navigate, click and type in a
browser holding the user's accounts. Tell it "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"not to sign in or out, post,
purchase or send anything unasked, and never to solve a CAPTCHA — and u"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"nderstand
that this is guidance, not enforcement."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**Proxied pages are sandboxed without `allow-same-origin`.** Everything the pane
shows is served fro"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"m the harness's own origin, so `allow-scripts` +
`allow-same-origin` together would let an arbitrary"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" site's JavaScript reach
`parent` and read the app around it. Local files are unsandboxed (own conte"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"nt,
and required for the PDF viewer); external pages are given an opaque origin."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**The asset route refuses to escape its directory.** The token names a directory
and a `../` in the "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"relative part is rejected — otherwise page content could
drive an arbitrary file read."}],"truncated":true}
